name: La Cumbre (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Cumbre (a mountain and ears of wheat on red).
history: The arms and the flag of La Cumbre were approved by the Order of 9 April 1991 of the Consejería de Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 16 April 1991, after the municipal council's approval on 19 July 1989.
